app.name: Atelier
app.tagline: Create screens on the Laravel repository with Cursor, a branch per person, and a live preview.
app.headline: Ship Laravel screens from a conversation.
app.lede: Each person gets a branch, Cursor in the loop, and a live preview of the portal — mobile, tablet, and desktop.
app.featureCollab: Invite the team, share a preview link
app.featureSpectator: Watch a session without taking the lock

auth.title: Sign in to the studio
auth.subtitle: Access follows your permission on ticoncreserv/app.

github.title: GitHub App credentials
github.lede: Create a GitHub App on the ticoncreserv organization. GitHub sends the client id, secret, and private key back to this studio.
github.hint: You need to be an organization owner. GitHub opens a review page, then redirects here with the credentials.
github.configured: GitHub login is configured for this process.
github.saved: GitHub created the app and stored the secrets on this machine. Install it on the target repository next.
github.installHint: Install only on that repository. Do not grant Administration.
github.envHint: Secrets live in {path} (gitignored). Copy them into .env so they survive a restart or another host.
github.permissions: Permissions: contents read and write, metadata read, pull requests read and write, email addresses read. No Administration.
github.oauthHint: A GitHub OAuth App also covers login. Use the same callback URL and set GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.
github.cursorTitle: Cursor ACP is a separate credential
github.cursorHint: GitHub App credentials and CURSOR_API_KEY are required. The studio clones ticoncreserv/app and runs prompts through Cursor ACP. MockProvider is tests-only.
github.blocked: GitHub App setup is disabled in this environment.
github.error: GitHub did not return app credentials. Try again.
github.used: That callback code is single-use. If the app was already created, the secrets are on this machine — install it next.
github.already: Credentials for this GitHub App are already on this machine. Install the app on ticoncreserv/app.
github.webhookHint: GitHub signs membership events with this secret. Paste it as the webhook secret on the app, and use the URL below. GitHub cannot reach 127.0.0.1 — deliveries wait until ATELIER_PUBLIC_URL is public.
github.accessedUrlsHint: Locally the studio answers on the listen port, plus localhost:80 and :8080. In production set ATELIER_PUBLIC_URL to the dedicated https domain — that origin replaces :43123.
github.callbackUrlsHint: Paste these into the GitHub App Callback URL list. Localhost entries are only for this machine. Production uses the public domain from ATELIER_PUBLIC_URL.
github.callbackUrlsSettings: Edit callback URLs on the GitHub App
github.oauthPasteHint: If a leftover callback still 404s, paste the code query here.
github.oauthSubmit: Finish GitHub sign-in with this code
github.oauthError: GitHub did not exchange that install code. Sign in again from this studio.
github.pasteHint: If GitHub opens a callback the browser cannot reach, copy the code query and paste it here.

nav.publishSoon: Publish is a later phase. The flag is off.

workspace.busy: Another session holds the run lock.
workspace.spectator: Spectator mode — you can watch, not prompt.
workspace.pendingMigrations: {count} migrations in your branch are not applied.
workspace.extraMigrations: {count} migrations exist in the database but not in your branch.
workspace.lockHeld: The run lock is held by another session.
workspace.noMigrations: No migrations have been applied from this studio yet.
workspace.resumeHint: Resume to open the app again. This can take a minute.
workspace.loadingHint: Reading the workspace and waking the Laravel preview.
workspace.loadError: The workspace could not be loaded.

chat.empty: Describe the screen or change you want. Mention routes with {'@'} and attach files or a screenshot.
chat.droppedContext: {count} context blocks did not fit the prompt budget.
chat.providerFailover: The Cursor account ran out of credit; trying the next one.
chat.cursorRequired: CURSOR_API_KEY is required. Prompts will not run until it is set in .env.
chat.providerRequired: An agent API key and CLI are required. Prompts will not run until a provider is configured.
chat.promptFailed: The prompt did not complete. Try again.
chat.usageBlocked: Token limit reached. Ask an admin for more room.
chat.modeHintAgent: Edit the worktree and run tools.
chat.modeHintPlan: Propose a plan before changing files.
chat.recipeHint: The recipe fills the prompt. Type the model or subject, then send.
chat.emptyHint: Start from a recipe, mention a route, or paste a screenshot.
chat.suggestion1: Add an Inertia page that lists quotes
chat.suggestion2: Add a status field to the Quote model

preview.title: Preview
preview.longQuery: Still querying the ERP ({seconds}s). The SQL timeout is 300s.
preview.inspectHint: Hover to highlight an element, then click to pin it. Drag to mark a region.
preview.debugEmpty: No metrics yet for this page.
preview.debugWaiting: Waiting for the first request metrics…
preview.debugMissing: Laravel Debugbar is not loaded. Turn on APP_DEBUG in the preview to collect time, queries, and memory.
preview.debugFix: Ask the agent to fix the last preview error
preview.debugFixNPlusOne: Ask the agent to investigate N+1 queries
preview.debugInvestigateSlow: Ask the agent about this slow request

debugPrompt.nPlusOne: Investigate this Laravel preview request. Look for N+1 queries, duplicate SQL, and other easy query wins in the current worktree.
debugPrompt.slow: This Laravel preview request looks expensive. Find the slow queries, redundant work, and easy wins in the current worktree, then fix what you can.
debugPrompt.query: Investigate this SQL from the Laravel preview request. Explain why it runs, whether it is N+1 or redundant, and fix it in the current worktree if that is cheap.

preview.waitResumingHint: Booting artisan serve and Vite on this branch. The iframe stays empty until /up answers.
preview.waitProvisioningHint: Cloning the branch and installing PHP and Node dependencies.
preview.waitIframeHint: This can take a few minutes.
preview.waitHydrating: The page arrived. Mounting the interface…
preview.waitHydratingHint: Vue and Inertia are hydrating. This can take a few seconds while Vite compiles.
preview.waitSlow: This can take a few minutes.
preview.waitSlowDb: This can take a few minutes.
preview.loadFailed: The preview page failed to load.
preview.loadFailedHint: The iframe did not finish loading. Resume the preview or refresh.

rules.userHint: Your personal preferences for this studio.
rules.lockedHint: Platform and project rules are edited in Admin.
rules.adminOnly: Only platform admins can change this layer.

settings.title: Workspace
settings.themeHint: Tint of buttons, links, and focus on this device.
settings.isolationHint: QUEUE_NAME, CACHE_PREFIX, SESSION_COOKIE, and APP_URL are unique per workspace.
settings.envFileHint: These keys override the shared repository .env for your clone. Isolation keys stay read-only. Resume preview after saving to reload Laravel.
settings.platformEnvHint: Platform credentials (GitHub, Cursor, ATELIER_PUBLIC_URL) live in the Atelier root .env, not in this overlay.
settings.overlaySaved: Overlay saved. Resume preview to apply it to Laravel.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.lede: Shared Laravel env, providers, users, and rules that apply to every studio.
admin.forbidden: You do not have access to the admin panel.
admin.setupBannerBody: Add the GitHub App and Cursor keys to the shared environment.
admin.errorsHint: Every live clone that failed to start or still carries a lastError. Open the logs, apply a suggested fix, or retry the preview.
admin.githubHint: OAuth and the GitHub App that clones ticoncreserv/app.
admin.cursorKeyHint: A signed-in CLI account or an API key. CLI accounts are tried first; keys are the fallback.
admin.publicUrlHint: Origin used for preview APP_URL and OAuth callbacks.
admin.envHint: Environment keys shared with every clone. A user overlay can override them. Isolation keys still win on preview start. Save writes var/env/global.env.
admin.envEmpty: No keys in this environment yet.
admin.removeKeyBody: This only removes the key from the draft. Save the environment to keep the change.
admin.applied: Rewrote worktree .env files. Resume a preview to reload Laravel.
admin.providersHint: Cursor is the default. Sign in CLI accounts on this host, then add API keys as fallback. Codex, Claude, Gemini, and Grok need their flag, at least one API key, and the CLI on PATH. Extra keys on the same provider take over when the current one is rejected. The default model is set here; workspaces cannot pick another.

providerMessage.unconfiguredCursor: Sign in a Cursor CLI account or add an API key
providerMessage.sandboxRequired: Sandbox is required but no backend is available
providerMessage.keysCooldown: All API keys are cooling down or exhausted
providerMessage.cursorCooldown: All Cursor CLI accounts and API keys are cooling down or exhausted

admin.providerKeysHint: Keys are written to the shared environment and never sent back to the browser. For Cursor they are the fallback after signed-in CLI accounts. The studio tries them in this order when a request is rejected for auth, quota, or rate limits.
admin.providerModelHint: Pinned per provider. The studio applies it when a session starts. People in a workspace cannot change it.
admin.providerModelDefault: Leave empty to keep the agent default

cursorCli.title: Cursor CLI accounts
cursorCli.hint: Each account uses an isolated CLI home on this host and is shared by every workspace. Signed-in accounts are tried first, in this order. API keys below are the fallback.
cursorCli.busy: Another account is already signing in
cursorCli.keysFallback: API keys are used when no CLI account can take the prompt.

admin.usersHint: People who signed in. Grant admin or deactivate accounts here. GitHub role is separate.
admin.lastAdmin: Cannot remove the last platform admin.
admin.cannotRevokeOwner: Cannot revoke the permanent platform admin.
admin.noUsers: No one has signed in yet.
admin.usageProfilesHint: Each plan is a monthly token budget. Cursor CLI accounts and keys are shared, so this ledger is what keeps one account from consuming the whole budget.
admin.usageLimitsOff: Limits are only measured right now. Turn on the usage limits flag to start blocking.
admin.usageUsersHint: Tokens counted in the current period. Assign a profile or grant extra tokens; every grant is recorded with who gave it.
admin.usageNoPeople: No one is on this plan yet. Move someone here from another plan.
admin.usageNoPeopleMatch: No one on this plan matches the search.
admin.usageDeletePlanBody: {count} on this plan. Move them to another plan before deleting.
admin.usageDeletePlanEmpty: No one is on this plan. You can delete it now.
admin.usageOccupied: Move people off this plan before deleting it.
admin.usageMigrateRequired: Choose a plan to move people onto.
admin.usageNoMonthlyCap: No monthly cap. Zero on a field means no limit.
admin.usageZeroHintShort: Zero means no limit on that field.
admin.usageZeroHint: Zero means no limit. The local count misses what the agent reads inside its own loop, so a provider that reports context is counted too.
admin.rulesHint: These layers are prepended to every prompt and written to AGENTS.md.
admin.skillsHint: These skills materialize into every worktree as .cursor/skills. Repository skills with the same name stay in charge.
admin.deleteSkillBody: This removes the global skill. Repository skills are not touched.
admin.mcpHint: Servers here merge with the repository .cursor/mcp.json. Disabled servers are not sent to the agent.
admin.mcpPolicyHint: Users may toggle repository and global servers. Adding a command server is only allowed when the command matches this list.
admin.mcpAllowUser: Users may add their own servers
admin.toolsApplied: Rewrote worktree skills and MCP config.
admin.flagsHint: Platform-wide switches. Publish stays off until that phase.

flagHint.publish: Ship a workspace branch to the dev environment.
flagHint.multiProvider: Let a workspace pick an agent other than Cursor.
flagHint.spectator: Read-only guests can watch a session live.
flagHint.recipes: Saved prompt recipes show up in the composer.
flagHint.skills: Discover repository skills and let the composer list them with /.
flagHint.mcp: Load MCP servers from the repository and extra layers into the agent session.
flagHint.secureWebSocket: Require a signed-in session before live chat events stream.
flagHint.safeUploads: Store uploads under generated names inside var/uploads.
flagHint.sandboxedAgent: Strip host secrets and wrap the agent process when bubblewrap is available.
flagHint.transactionalReview: Keep agent edits as a proposal until hunks are accepted.
flagHint.validationGate: Run targeted checks before committing accepted changes.
flagHint.autoPush: Push the studio branch after an accepted checkpoint.
flagHint.workspaceQueue: Queue a second prompt instead of failing with a busy workspace.
flagHint.realProviderEvals: Run live ACP evals in addition to transcript scoring.
flagHint.sandboxRequired: Fail closed unless bubblewrap or a sandbox image can wrap the agent process.
flagHint.postgresStore: Read and write the platform store from flattened Postgres-shaped rows (snapshot until DATABASE_URL exists).
flagHint.postgresShadowRead: Keep JSON as primary and shadow-write the flattened snapshot.
flagHint.claudeProvider: Allow Claude via npx {'@'}agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp when multi-provider is on.
flagHint.geminiProvider: Allow Gemini via gemini --acp when multi-provider is on.
flagHint.grokProvider: Allow Grok via grok agent stdio when multi-provider is on.
flagHint.codexProvider: Allow Codex (ChatGPT) via npx {'@'}agentclientprotocol/codex-acp when multi-provider is on.
flagHint.providerCanary: Hide extra providers from workspace pickers unless ATELIER_PROVIDER_CANARY=1.
flagHint.usageMetering: Record tokens, cost, and tool calls per run in the local usage ledger.
flagHint.usageLimits: Enforce the token limits of each usage profile.

admin.workspacesHint: Every live clone. Hibernate frees artisan and Vite ports. Delete removes the local clone.
admin.lastRunning: Cannot hibernate the last running workspace.
admin.deleteWorkspaceBody: This stops the preview and removes the local clone. The GitHub branch, user overlay, and chat history stay.
admin.disabledBody: This account cannot use the studio. Contact a platform admin if that is a mistake.
admin.deactivateBody: They can still sign in, but every studio and admin API will refuse the session until you reactivate them.
admin.cannotDisableOwner: Cannot disable the permanent platform admin.
admin.cannotDisableEnv: Cannot disable an admin listed in ATELIER_ADMIN_LOGINS.

enospc.title: File watcher limit
enospc.detail: Vite or PHP hit the OS watch limit. Resume after raising fs.inotify.max_user_watches, or hibernate idle clones.

vite.title: Vite failed to boot
vite.detail: Confirm node_modules/.bin/vite exists in the clone, then retry the preview. A fresh resume rewrites the atelier Vite config.

artisan.title: Laravel /up never answered
artisan.detail: Inspect the artisan log for boot errors. Homologation DB hosts that hang can block artisan; isolation env should force local sqlite for CLI.

composer.title: PHP dependencies missing
composer.detail: The clone may be missing vendor/. Reprovision or run composer install inside the worktree, then retry.

cursor.title: Cursor agent credentials
cursor.detail: Open Environment / Providers and confirm CURSOR_API_KEY. MCP env must be an array for session/new.

eisdir.title: Agent tried to read a directory
eisdir.detail: Usually a stale prompt against a folder path. Retry a narrower ask, or clear the errored session and start a new one.

homolog.title: Homologation hosts unreachable
homolog.detail: 10.x DB hosts are expected to time out outside the VPN. Preview /up should still work; screens needing MySQL will fail until those hosts answer.

docker.title: Docker runtime unavailable
docker.detail: Set ATELIER_RUNTIME=process (default) when the Docker daemon is not present on this host.

retry.title: Retry the preview
retry.detail: Clear ports with hibernate if needed, then resume. Read the artisan/Vite logs for the exact stack.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Skills come from the repository first. Your own skills and platform skills are written into .cursor/skills when they are not shadowed.
skills.empty: No skills discovered in this worktree yet.
skills.name: Name
skills.deleteBody: This removes your skill. Repository skills stay.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.hint: The repository owns .cursor/mcp.json. Extra servers from you or the platform are merged in. Disabled servers are not loaded.
mcp.empty: No MCP servers in this workspace yet.
mcp.name: Server name
mcp.deleteBody: This removes your custom server. Repository servers stay.
mcp.tooMany: Many servers are on. Extra tools can crowd the agent.
